title: Hotels with a Hagia Sophia view: which room to book
metaDescription: Four Istanbul hotels around Sultanahmet with Hagia Sophia view rooms, the exact room category to book, and the Blue Mosque and city view rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Hagia Sophia view, and which room to book
dek: Four hotels in Sultanahmet, the old city of Istanbul. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the view, and the Blue Mosque, garden and plain rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: From five suite categories named for the view to a hotel that sells none.

alternatives.title: No view room? Try a rooftop
alternatives.text: Museum Pass Istanbul names the rooftop lounge at the Four Seasons Hotel Istanbul at Sultanahmet and the rooftop terrace at the White House Hotel Istanbul for views of Hagia Sophia. It describes both as shared spaces, not rooms.

faq.q: Which Istanbul hotels sell rooms with a Hagia Sophia view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: Seven Hills Hotel, Hotel Saint Sophia and Sura Hagia Sophia Hotel sell categories with Hagia Sophia in the name. The Four Seasons Hotel Istanbul at Sultanahmet sells none, but a travel agent says its Deluxe rooms have partial views of Hagia Sophia or the Blue Mosque.

faq.q: Why does Hotels.com say “City view” for a Hagia Sophia View room?
faq.a: The view tag on a booking site is a generic label. At Hotel Saint Sophia, the Grand Deluxe Room with Hagia Sophia View is tagged as a city view. The room name is the promise.

faq.q: Is a Blue Mosque view the same as a Hagia Sophia view?
faq.a: No. They are different buildings. The Seven Hills Hotel sells a Suite with Hagia Sophia View and a Suite with Blue Mosque View as separate categories.

faq.q: Do the other Sultanahmet hotels with views sell a room for it?
faq.a: The Guide Istanbul says the Armada Old City and the Ottoman Hotel Imperial have Hagia Sophia views. None of their room names on Hotels.com or Expedia mentions it, so we don't list a room to book.
